items.title: The Witch and the Beast
items.reason: Across the complete 12-episode 2024 anime, cursed, ferocious Guideau and reserved mage Ashaf work for the Order of Magical Resonance, investigating witch-related incidents while hunting the witch responsible for Guideau's curse. Short arcs involve a revered but dangerous witch, occult serial murders, necromancy and a magic sword pursued by rival executioners. The pair identify concealed motives, learn limits of curses and forbidden magical tools, and encounter different forms of witchcraft and powerful combatants. Gothic quasi-European cityscapes, violent confrontations, dismemberment, morally compromised institutions and unusual magic give it a dark supernatural atmosphere. Guideau's temporarily released original body is extremely strong, but this is not structured training or steady power growth; cases involve deduction more than continuous adversarial mind games. The first season resolves local incidents but leaves the central hunt and major world mysteries open. Whole-season reviewers praise its character designs and some cases while criticizing repetitive exposition, minimal development of the leads, uneven pacing, often stiff or declining animation and action direction, and a finale that mostly sets up future material. The 12-episode anime only, not subsequent manga, is the evidence scope.
